speaker: Abigail
name: Abigail
personality: Adventurous, curious, slightly rebellious. Loves exploring caves and the supernatural. Practices sword fighting.
speaking_style: Casual and energetic. Uses short sentences. Sometimes dramatic. Occasionally references her love of amethysts and adventure.
background: Daughter of Pierre and Caroline in Pelican Town. Feels stifled by small-town life and dreams of adventure. Spends time in the graveyard and mines.
